test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

No mirror is sunglasses. All mirrors are lenses. 

**Conclusions:**

1. All sunglasses are lenses. 

2. Some sunglasses are lenses.
solution:
Statements:

No mirror is sunglasses.

All mirrors are lenses. 

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bc3d17f839dd7bdded7e144a9c42c17374f36e7a6fbe0ff089f468f0f3a330e.png] 

Conclusions:

1. All sunglasses are lenses. - **False **(because, No mirror is sunglasses and All mirrors are lenses, so All sunglasses are lenses it can be possible but not definite)

2. Some sunglasses are lenses. - **False **(because, No mirror is sunglasses and All mirrors are lenses, so All sunglasses are lenses it can be possible but not definite)

So, Neither conclusion 1 nor 2 follows.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Neither conclusion 1 nor 2 follows."**
